role.normalized_title: Financial Controller (six-month contract; approximate monthly benchmark)

evidence.claim: A Network Finance-branded PNet advert for Financial Controller (Contract) (ID 4272034; ref NFR011208-LEA-1) was visible in the profile 51189 snapshot.
evidence.basis: Direct PNet detail page and profile snapshot; Network Finance is the advertiser, not a verified hiring employer.

evidence.claim: The direct page describes a six-month operational Financial Controller contract in Thornton, with cashbook, international payments, FX, cash flow, VAT/PAYE, reconciliations, audit, Sage 300/Accpac and import/export duties.
evidence.basis: Direct PNet detail-page description and stated requirements.

evidence.claim: The body states “market-related remuneration – benchmark approximately R50,000 per month, flexible for the right candidate.” Multiplication by 12 gives an approximate R600,000 annualized run rate, above the R420,000 p.a. screen; the rate is not guaranteed and the six-month contract total would be approximately R300,000 at that benchmark.
evidence.basis: Direct Package & Remuneration block or, for 4272034, approximate monthly benchmark in the advert body. Annualization is arithmetic only and the 4272034 amount is not guaranteed.

evidence.claim: The end employer is not identified in the retrieved direct advert.
evidence.basis: The page names Network Finance as advertiser and uses anonymous client/sector wording; no employer name is displayed.

evidence.claim: PNet showed the page as published 1 week ago at retrieval; employer-side acceptance remains unverified.
evidence.basis: Direct page was retrievable on 2026-10-07; no closing date or employer confirmation was shown.

evidence.claim: The end employer is not evidenced as Boschendal or Laurium; client status remains unknown.
evidence.basis: No employer name or agreed-client relationship appears in the listing.

evidence.claim: Possible duplicate/repost with 4271281: both are 6-month Financial Controller ads in Cape Town's Northern Suburbs with near-identical international/product-focused accounting, cashbook, foreign-currency, import/export and Sage 300 scope. Recruiter, reference and pay expression differ; do not merge as confirmed.
evidence.basis: Cross-page comparison of direct PNet source IDs/references and descriptions; no recruiter confirmation.

next_action: Confirm whether the two contract-controller references are the same requisition, resolve the body-versus-metadata contract conflict and approximate salary floor, identify the end employer, and verify current acceptance.

geography.search_term_matched: Network Finance PNet Western Cape profile 51189

taxonomy.boundary_rule_applied: Raw title Financial Controller maps to node 7. The direct body says urgent six-month contract; PNet header says Permanent / Full Time. Annualized benchmark clears the annual-rate screen only approximately; do not represent the amount as guaranteed or the total six-month engagement value as R600,000.

client_relationship.basis: End employer is not identified; no agreed-client identity or relationship is evidenced.

pay_evidence: Approx. R50,000/month benchmark (annualized approx. R600,000; flexible, not guaranteed); six-month contract means approximate total at that benchmark is R300,000. Page metadata says Permanent / Full Time while body says six-month contract.
